name: Scootaloo
source:
An orange pegasus pony with purple eyes and a purple mane and tail. She usually sees [url=/c11575]Rainbow Dash[/url] as a sister. Scootaloo is a tomboy like Rainbow Dash; she is adventurous, brave, and opinionated. 

Even though she can't exactly fly, she uses her tiny wings to give her extra propulsion when riding a scooter and to help her perform stunts. She can also hover for short periods. She idolizes Rainbow Dash, and is the president of "The Rainbow Dash Fan Club".
